title: 4-to-1 Multiplexer and Priority Encoder
description: Synthesizable combinational 4-to-1 bus multiplexer paired with a 4-input active-high priority encoder using IEEE 1364 Verilog always @(*) case logic.

title: Synchronous FIFO Ring Buffer
description: Four-entry 8-bit synchronous FIFO circular buffer with read/write pointers, occupancy counter, and full/empty status flags in synthesizable Verilog RTL.

title: SPI Master Serial Controller FSM
description: Mode-0 Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI) master controller finite state machine generating SCLK, chip-select CS_N, and full-duplex MOSI/MISO 8-bit shift transfers.

title: Parameterized PWM Motor Driver with Testbench
description: Multi-file complementary H-bridge PWM motor controller with dead-time insertion, shared Verilog header definitions (pwm_defs.vh), and verification testbench (tb_pwm.v).

files.pwm_defs.vh:
// Shared PWM Motor Driver Configuration Constants
`define PWM_PERIOD_DEFAULT   8'd200
`define PWM_DEADTIME_DEFAULT 8'd4
`define PWM_DUTY_HALF        8'd100

title: Single-Cycle 16-Bit RISC Core
description: Multi-file single-cycle 16-bit RISC processor core integrating instruction decode and PC control (cpu_top.v), 16-bit ALU (alu.v), dual-port register file (regfile.v), ISA header (isa.vh), and testbench (tb_cpu.v).
